question: Establishment Democrat?
headline: Mixed
summary: House Democrats chose him as top Democrat on Oversight, 150–63, and he votes with most Democrats on nearly every roll call. But he is a Progressive Caucus member who took little money from party leaders' committees, none from Jeffries' or the DCCC, and broke with most Democrats on the January 2026 funding bills and a crypto-friendly IRS vote.
why: "Mixed" because the signs point both ways: party-line voting (rank {rank} of {dems} among House Democrats) and a leadership post voted by the caucus count as establishment; progressive-caucus membership, {lead26} from party leaders' committees in 2025–26 and breaks on funding bills count as independent.
